current.summary: Built straight down docs/build-order.md: finished Phase 2 (booking request, rate & review), built Phase 3 whole (the loop prompt, its four suppression rules and both placements), then closed all three of Phase 1's remainder items - the consent-supersede redirect, session persistence, and local_auth. 177 tests to 254, analyze clean, debug APK green. Committed and pushed.
current.state: Phases 1-3 complete in code and untested on a handset; no backend; four brand cuts still over the fetch cap
decisions: Phase 3 was buildable despite the journey map marking it `gap` - the map gives trigger points, pairs, four states and one finished line of copy; only the artboard is missing. LoopPair.verbatim marks which string is the design's
Rides is a target and never a source for the loop prompt: dispatch has no browse to land on, and it is the highest-frequency category
An unknown supply figure counts as thin - not knowing whether a room is empty is not grounds for sending someone into it
A restored session never comes back active. That is the one way persistence could be wrong that matters
ServiceDirection.either kept against the canvas, because booking.md makes 'Both' a listing property; the customer still picks one of two
The rating star reads palette.accentText, not the canvas's #145A8D literal - identical in light, legible in dark
'you pay them directly' where the canvas writes 'him' of a provider named Kabelo - it is a template for every provider
No refreshListenable on the consent redirect: Consent.current is a compile-time constant, so the case it catches is a restored session
working: Phase 2 complete: booking request, status with eleven states, rate & review, joined by the auth gate. Sending is a replace; submit is dead until a star is tapped
Phase 3 complete: four pairs, four suppression rules, two placements. Only rentals-to-movers fires against real supply figures, and a test pins that
Consent supersede enforced by a router redirect, with visitors and locked sessions deliberately exempt
The session persists and never returns active - biometry on restores to locked, biometry off goes back through the code
Biometric unlock wired to the platform: two distinct prompts, the no-sensor state handled both directions, refusals silent
254 tests, flutter analyze clean, flutter build apk --debug green
notWorking: Nothing built since 2026-08-20 has been seen on a handset - Phase 0's colour and motion gate is owed on all of it
No backend: a sent request never becomes a booking, a review is dropped, DemoOtpVerifier accepts any four digits
Four brand cuts still exceed the 256 KiB fetch cap
Ten of eleven booking actions are inert; only COMPLETED goes anywhere
No picker behind the booking request's WHEN card - scheduling granularity is still open
doNotRepeat: A cat <<'EOF' heredoc through the Bash tool for a ~430-line Dart file dies with 'unexpected EOF'. Use the Write tool for whole files
Bulk string-replacing call shapes (state = state.copyWith( to _set(state.copyWith() changes arity and leaves every call a paren short. Analyze before moving on
Putting a policy only in the shipping store while tests run against the in-memory one means tests pass against behaviour the app does not have. Both stores now share one write
local_auth 3.x is not 2.x: no error_codes.dart, no AuthenticationOptions, stickyAuth is persistAcrossBackgrounding, errors are typed LocalAuthException

Carried: stripping <script> when flattening a canvas; transcribing a binary out of a tool result; Get-Content/Set-Content on a source file; CrossAxisAlignment.stretch on a Row inside a ListView; a modal on a tab's Navigator; a here-string for git commit -m
nextSteps: Run Phase 0's gate on everything built since 2026-08-20 - a Pixel in both modes, colour and motion
Verify biometric unlock on real hardware; it builds and is unit-tested behind a fake, but the sensor path has never run
Phase 4: becoming a provider paired with the admin queue. This is where the backend starts - Django on /staff/*, PROVIDER_CATEGORY, ADMIN_ACTION, DOCUMENT_ACCESS. Postgres is already running
blockers: BLOCKING, only the user can clear it: mark-dark, wordmark-dark-new, lockup-dark and logo-light-transparent all exceed the 256 KiB get_file cap
Undesigned so not startable: the dispute FLOW (UC-13), customer-provider messaging, provider listing management at scale, empty and offline states
Late-cancellation fee amount; no-show consequence for providers; commission rate per category; dispute turnaround
Carried: reversal policy, negative balance, min top-up, hosting durability, EPS licensing, data residency, KYC retention, GPS DPIA
Noted not fixed: the design numbers two screens 21, and Session.maxCodeAttempts (5) is the repo's number

lastCommit.subject: Build the booking status screen: all eleven states

archive.summary: Read the design properly and repaired everything built on a partial reading of it. Five rounds of user pushback, each correct: the design project was reachable all along; only one canvas of five had been read; docs must precede Dart; wrong documentation is an emergency because everything downstream inherits it; and the flattener was stripping <script>, which is where the design keeps PAL, CATS, REQUIREMENTS and all eleven BSTATES. Brand imported and shipped - launcher, adaptive, splash and notification icons all real and verified on device. Colour and type verified against the canvas rather than assumed. Booking status built with all eleven states.

Followed docs/build-order.md rather than re-deriving it. Closed Phase 0 by running all five built screens on a Pixel 9a in both modes - the first time this app has been seen rendered. The palette came back exact; the supply count was ellipsised and is fixed. The run exposed that the app has no identity at all, raised by the user mid-session: stock Flutter icon, white cold-start flash, no mark. Fixed what needed no artwork, made the rest an enforced artifact. Then built Phase 1 in full: seven entry routes plus the auth gate, with the entry rules held as states in core/session.dart. 147 tests.
